title: All-Party Parliamentary Group on Chalk Streams
purpose: The APPG champions the protection, enhancement and restoration of the UK’s chalk streams. Our purpose is to raise awareness within parliament and government of the pressures facing chalk streams, promote nature’s recovery and improve the ecological status of these globally rare river habitats.
